RBAC_PERM_SETTINGS_READ_DESC: Allow reading system settings and plugin settings.
RBAC_PERM_SETTINGS_MANAGE_DESC: Allow updating system settings and plugin settings.
RBAC_PERM_SITE_MANAGE_DESC: Allow managing workspace site operations such as issuing preview tokens.
RBAC_PERM_CONTENT_READ_DESC: Allow viewing content models, entries, pages, structures, and appearance settings.
RBAC_PERM_CONTENT_MANAGE_DESC: Allow creating and editing content models, entries, pages, structures, and appearance settings.
RBAC_PERM_CONTENT_PUBLISH_DESC: Allow publishing, unpublishing, and rolling back content revisions.
RBAC_PERM_KEYS_READ_DESC: Allow listing and reading workspace service keys and delivery keys.
RBAC_PERM_KEYS_MANAGE_DESC: Allow creating, revoking, and rotating workspace service keys and delivery keys.
RBAC_PERM_THEMES_READ_DESC: Allow viewing installed themes and theme package details.
RBAC_PERM_THEMES_MANAGE_DESC: Allow importing and uninstalling workspace themes.
RBAC_PERM_ASSETS_READ_DESC: Allow listing and viewing asset library items, folders, tags, and usages.
RBAC_PERM_ASSETS_MANAGE_DESC: Allow uploading, updating, moving, deleting, and organizing asset library items and usages.
RBAC_PERM_DOMAINS_READ_DESC: Allow viewing site custom domain bindings and verification status.
RBAC_PERM_DOMAINS_MANAGE_DESC: Allow binding, verifying, updating, and deleting site custom domains.
RBAC_PERM_NOTIFICATIONS_READ_DESC: Allow listing and reading workspace notifications.
RBAC_PERM_NOTIFICATIONS_MANAGE_DESC: Allow managing notification workflows such as seeding demo notifications.
RBAC_PERM_AUTOMATION_READ_DESC: Allow viewing automation flows, runs, and diagnostics.
RBAC_PERM_AUTOMATION_MANAGE_DESC: Allow creating, updating, deleting, and operating automation flows.
RBAC_PERM_RBAC_ROLES_READ_DESC: Allow listing roles and role details in current workspace.
RBAC_PERM_RBAC_ROLES_WRITE_DESC: Allow creating, updating, and deleting custom roles in current workspace.
RBAC_PERM_RBAC_USERS_ASSIGN_DESC: Allow assigning and revoking user roles in current workspace.
RBAC_PERM_ADMIN_USERS_READ_DESC: Allow listing users and reading user details in admin console.
RBAC_PERM_ADMIN_USERS_WRITE_DESC: Allow creating, updating, enabling and disabling users in admin console.
RBAC_PERM_ADMIN_USERS_RESET_PW_DESC: Allow resetting user password in admin console.
RBAC_PERM_TEAM_MEMBERS_READ_DESC: Allow listing members in current workspace.
RBAC_PERM_TEAM_MEMBER_ROLES_MANAGE_DESC: Allow managing member role bindings in current workspace.
RBAC_PERM_TEAM_MEMBERS_MANAGE_DESC: Allow enabling/disabling members and updating member profiles in current workspace.
RBAC_PERM_TEAM_MEMBERS_RESET_PW_DESC: Allow resetting user password for a member in current workspace.
RBAC_PERM_TEAM_INVITES_MANAGE_DESC: Allow creating, listing, renewing and revoking invites in current workspace.
RBAC_PERM_TEAM_INVITE_LINKS_MANAGE_DESC: Allow managing reusable invite links in current workspace.
RBAC_PERM_EXTENSIONS_READ_DESC: Allow listing extensions/integrations and reading their details.
RBAC_PERM_EXTENSIONS_MANAGE_DESC: Allow enabling, disabling and configuring extensions/integrations.
RBAC_ROLE_ADMIN_DESC: Manage members, settings, and permission policies.
RBAC_ROLE_DESIGNER_DESC: Manage themes, pages, and presentation styles.
RBAC_ROLE_VIEWER_DESC: Read-only access to the admin console.
